result: passed for Java core tests and Android API compilation; device audio not exercised

java_core_test.runtime: Actual JVM execution; no Android or native TTS mocks
coverage: Individual-sentence/long-sentence segmentation, quoted punctuation, paragraph breaks, abbreviations, and surrogate-pair boundaries
Contiguous completed-character progress, out-of-order/duplicate/old session callbacks, interrupted-segment retry, and word/reading context replacement
Invalid new input preserves the active playback session
Pause waits, resume wakes the worker without losing completed progress, and stop wakes/invalidates a paused worker
Bounded PCM LRU memory accounting, replacement, eviction, and invalid-sample rejection
Two-thread native-release/queued-filesystem-delete window: the target model remains blocked until actual delete finally
Independent models remain available; duplicate delete gates and failed-delete finally recovery

android_api_compile.scope: Final direct SDK compilation of all current application Java sources, including the fixed British Kokoro adapter and Activity deletion guard; all three APKs use identical DEX.
real_dependencies: Official sherpa-onnx Android 1.13.8 classes and JNI adapter
android_api_compile.note: Compilation verifies Java/API compatibility. It does not prove JNI inference or audio output on a phone.

system_tts.queue: One segment at a time; unique utterance identity plus binding/session tokens reject old callbacks
system_tts.pause: Stop the current system utterance and invalidate its callback identity
system_tts.resume: Replay the current unfinished sentence/segment, keeping the completed prefix; unusually long sentences may be split for engine limits

offline_tts.synthesis: Native model construction, generation and close run serially on a background executor
offline_tts.audio: Float PCM through streaming AudioTrack with non-blocking writes; wait for actual playback head before recording a completed segment
offline_tts.pause: AudioTrack.pause retains queued samples and playhead; the worker waits while paused
offline_tts.resume: AudioTrack.play continues the retained queue at its audio position, without synthesizing or replaying heard samples
offline_tts.stop: Invalidate the playback token and immediately pause/flush audio; late synthesis output cannot start a replacement session
offline_tts.cache_key: provider + model ID + speaker ID + speaker locale + speed + segment text; bounded RAM cache, no reading PCM on disk

playback_design_review.model_delete: Persistent per-model gate starts before releaseModel and ends only in Main delete finally via modelDeletionFinished; JNI release alone does not reopen the model. Current matching offline playback stops, other models continue.

device_runtime_validation.note: All pause/resume and native-runtime descriptions above are implementation/design review, not measured hardware playback results.
